fee_items.source_note: Water capacity ($1.88/sq ft) and supply ($1.74/sq ft) apply only to net new floor area over 1,000 sq ft, so $0 for an 800 sq ft ADU on an existing meter.
fee_items.notes: A new 1-inch connection, if required, is a separate scenario ($37,831) and is excluded as scenario-dependent.

fee_items.threshold: Net new floor area 1,000 sq ft or less
fee_items.source_note: Wastewater capacity ($0.53/sq ft) applies only to residential additions over 1,000 sq ft, so $0 for an 800 sq ft ADU.

fee_items.fee_name: Planning fee for a building-permit-only ADU
fee_items.source_note: A compliant ADU is approved with a building permit only and no planning application fee applies, so $0 for an 800 sq ft ADU.
fee_items.notes: The ADU Use Permit lines ($5,826 staff / $15,589 commission) are for the discretionary path only.

fee_items.fee_name: General Plan Maintenance / Long Range Planning Fee
fee_items.source_note: 0.00187 per dollar of project valuation ($1.87 per $1,000) on all development in the FY2025-26 fee book.
fee_items.notes: Rate shown as a percent of valuation (0.187%).

fee_items.source_note: $92 on all development permits and plan review in the FY2025-26 fee book.
$4 per $100,000 of valuation ($1 per $25,000), minimum $1, in the FY2025-26 fee book.
fee_items.notes: Rate shown as a percent of valuation (0.004%). Scope in source: project valuation.

fee_items.source_note: $4 per application in the FY2025-26 fee book.
$35 per permit in the FY2025-26 fee book.
ADU-specific Certificate of Occupancy is $447 per application in the FY2025-26 fee book (general C of O is $1,214).
Covenant processing is $1,416 for the 4-hour minimum in the FY2025-26 fee book, so $1,416 is the minimum for an 800 sq ft ADU.
fee_items.notes: Plus $307 per additional hour and City Attorney costs at actual cost.

fee_items.fee_name: Water capacity charge, detached ADU over 150 sq ft
fee_items.source_note: Confirmed ADU rate $3.04/sq ft over 150 sq ft; the assessable basis is ambiguous, giving $1,976 on the excess-over-150 reading (650 sq ft) and $2,432 on the full-area reading (800 sq ft).
fee_items.notes: Range included per task rule for a confirmed official-schedule rate with an ambiguous basis; 12/1 should fix the basis. City-operated water system, SFPUC wholesale.

fee_items.fee_name: Sewer capacity charge, detached ADU over 150 sq ft
fee_items.source_note: Confirmed ADU rate $4.63/sq ft over 150 sq ft; the assessable basis is ambiguous, giving $3,009.50 on the excess-over-150 reading and $3,704 on the full-area reading for an 800 sq ft ADU.
fee_items.notes: Range included per task rule; 12/1 should fix the basis. City owns its collection system and wastewater treatment plant.

fee_items.source_note: ADU application fee $950 in the FY2024-25 Master Fee Schedule and the ADU submittal packet, which shows a $1,091 example total including the $141 Categorical Exemption.
fee_items.notes: Ministerial processing; no design-review fee for a compliant ADU. The 2026-27 schedule extraction did not surface an ADU line, so 12/1 should confirm currency.

fee_items.fee_name: General Plan and Title 25 Zoning Ordinance Maintenance Fee
fee_items.source_note: 0.2% of building valuation in the Master Fee Schedules.
fee_items.notes: Scope in source: project valuation.

fee_items.fee_name: Plumbing, mechanical and electrical permits (new residential)
fee_items.source_note: Each MEP permit is $0.18/sq ft plus a $99 issuance fee, so 3 x ($144 + $99) = $729 on an 800 sq ft ADU, before any 25% plan-review add-ons.
Affordable housing impact fees apply only to commercial linkage and multifamily at scale (11+ rental / 7+ for-sale units), so $0 for a single detached ADU.

fee_items.fee_name: School developer fee, Chico Unified (Level I, residential)
fee_items.source_note: Chico Unified posts $5.38/sq ft residential effective 7/19/2026 on its official School Impact Fees page, giving $4,304 on an 800 sq ft ADU.
fee_items.notes: Unified TK-12 district, full Level I, no elementary/high-school split. The 2026 adopting resolution number was not retrieved; 12/1 should close that paper trail, but the rate and effective date are officially posted.

fee_items.fee_name: ADU Permit, new detached structure or detached conversion
fee_items.source_note: FY2026/2027 Master Fee Schedule planning fee for a new detached ADU is $1,460 (up from $1,207 in FY2025/2026).
fee_items.notes: Ministerial processing; discretionary planning fees do not apply.

fee_items.source_note: Energy Plan Check minimum fee is $282 for up to 2 residential units in the FY2026/2027 schedule.
fee_items.notes: Scope in source: ADU.

fee_items.source_note: Seismic surcharge is 0.013% of established construction valuation for residential occupancies up to 3 stories, minimum $0.50, in the FY2026/2027 schedule.
fee_items.notes: Scope in source: project valuation.

fee_items.threshold: ADU on an existing served lot, no new meter requested
fee_items.source_note: Chico has no city water utility (Cal Water Chico District serves the city) and city ADU standards state no additional water meter is required unless the applicant requests one, so $0 city water connection fee for the spec ADU.
fee_items.notes: Cal Water Rule 15 charges, if a new/upgraded service is requested, are PARTIAL and excluded.

fee_items.source_note: PGMC 23.80.040(a) allows a compliant ADU with a building permit and no discretionary planning approval, and no ADU fee line appears in the Master Fee Schedule, so $0 for an 800 sq ft ADU.
fee_items.notes: Discretionary planning fees do not apply to a ministerial detached ADU.

fee_items.threshold: Sewer lateral inspection report required before framing inspection
fee_items.source_note: Sewer Lateral Report Review is $351 in the FY2026-27 Master Fee Schedule (FY2025-26: $334).
fee_items.notes: A sewer lateral inspection report is required before framing inspection per the city ADU checklist.

fee_items.threshold: New detached structure or addition 1,000 sq ft or less
fee_items.source_note: Public Facilities Impact Fee is $0.40/sq ft only on new detached structures or additions over 1,000 sq ft, so $0 for an 800 sq ft ADU.
Development Fee Summary Section I lists an accessory dwelling unit at $0.00 (vs $21,885 for a single-family detached home), so $0 for an 800 sq ft ADU.

fee_items.threshold: New floor area under 2,000 sq ft or valuation under $500,000
fee_items.source_note: The 0.75%-of-valuation allocation applies only to projects with 2,000 sq ft or more of new floor area and $500,000 or more valuation, so $0 for an 800 sq ft ADU.
FY2026-27 new ADU schedule: $2,455 base plus $4.00 per sq ft over 500 sq ft, giving $3,655 for an 800 sq ft ADU.
fee_items.notes: Items 73-74, each marked new per study. MEP sub-permits and inspection hours are additional and untotaled.

fee_items.source_note: Plan check is 67% of the building payment in the FY2026-27 schedule, giving $2,448.85 on the $3,655 ADU building fee.
fee_items.notes: Plus $110 permit issuance (Item 126) and MEP sub-permits, not encoded as separate items here because MEP totals are untotaled in the file.

fee_items.fee_name: School developer fee — Folsom Cordova USD, Level II, SFID 2 (Folsom)
fee_items.source_note: FCUSD official fee page: SFID 2 (representing the City of Folsom) $10.26/sq ft residential, eff. 4/16/2026; 800 sq ft = $8,208. ADUs of 500 sq ft or less of assessable space are excluded.
fee_items.notes: Unified TK-12 district; Level I $5.38 justified in parallel only. Board resolution number not retrieved (12/1 target), but rate and effective date are on the district's official page. Scope in source: detached ADU.

fee_items.fee_name: Building permit — Detached and Attached ADUs (flat fee, plan review and inspection included)
fee_items.source_note: Resolution No. 11481, Exhibit A, Section A Item 18: Detached and Attached ADUs $4,709 per permit, including plan review and inspection. Section A header: effective July 1, 2025.
fee_items.notes: Flat fee does not vary with ADU size or valuation. Subject to annual CPI adjustment; CPI-adjusted late-2026 figure not retrieved (12/1 target). Scope in source: detached ADU.

fee_items.source_note: No standalone ADU planning fee in Resolution No. 11481; an 800 sq ft ADU at or under 16 ft on a non-Historic District lot is an exempted ADU, so design-review fee is $0.
fee_items.notes: Non-exempt ADU lines ($400 Director-level Item 6(d); $864 Ministerial Item 6(k)) do not apply to the spec ADU. Scope in source: detached ADU.

fee_items.source_note: Resolution No. 11481, Building Fees Section E: Permit Processing Fee $79; the Section A header (effective July 1, 2025) confirms additional permit processing fees apply to the flat-fee permit types.
fee_items.notes: Scope in source: detached ADU.

fee_items.fee_name: Water service connection charge — ADU sharing the existing service (Golden State Water Company)
fee_items.source_note: GSWC Rule No. 16 (Advice Letter 1946-W, eff. 8/31/2024): no charge for a service connection except enumerated cases, and no capital-facilities schedule applies to Claremont (about 11,000 connections, above the 2,000-connection threshold); an ADU sharing the existing service therefore pays $0 in connection charges.
fee_items.notes: A separately requested second ADU service is billed at actual cost (estimate-based, no fixed tariff amount), not $0. Sharing the service may reclassify the account to multi-family rates or require a larger meter (monthly service-rate consequences, not a connection fee). Scope in source: detached ADU.

fee_items.source_note: No ADU, JADU, or SB 9 application line exists in the FY27 Master Schedule (Reso CC 2026-41) or the Planning Division fee sheet (Rev. Jul 2026); ADUs are ministerial, so the ADU planning application fee is $0.
fee_items.notes: Technology User Fee 19% applies to planning applications generally, but with no ADU application fee there is no base to apply it to for the spec ADU. Scope in source: detached ADU.

fee_items.source_note: Resolution No. 2026-4387, Planning Item 23: Zoning Clearance $210 fixed; an ADU requires approval of a zoning clearance (Moorpark Zoning Code 17.28.020(G)) and there is no standalone ADU planning fee.
fee_items.notes: Subject to the 6% Technology Enhancement Fee (Planning Item 52), a percentage add-on not included here because the schema's percentage method is valuation-based. Scope in source: detached ADU.

fee_items.fee_name: Parkland and Recreation Facility Development Impact Fee for ADUs (single-family detached)
fee_items.source_note: Ordinance No. 2065 / Resolution No. 15578 (June 15, 2026), Exhibit B2: ADU park DIF $1.25/sq ft at the current 50% phase; 800 sq ft = $1,000. ADUs under 750 sq ft are exempt per Gov. Code 66324(c)(1).
fee_items.notes: Phased schedule: $1.88/sq ft on 7/1/2027, $2.50/sq ft on 7/1/2028, plus ENR CCI adjustments from 7/1/2027. First phase effective 60 days after adoption (mid-August 2026, exact date not pinned). Whether the counter adds a 66324 proportionality-to-primary overlay to this standalone per-sq-ft ADU rate is not stated (12/1 target). Scope in source: detached ADU.

fee_items.fee_name: Water capacity charge — qualifying newly constructed detached ADU (Marin Municipal Water District)
fee_items.source_note: Marin Water Ordinance No. 469, section 11.56.040(h)(3): no new or separate water service and no capacity charge for one qualifying detached ADU per lot, so the capacity charge is $0 when the conditions are met.
fee_items.notes: Conditions: ADU no more than 1,200 sq ft, lot with an existing primary dwelling already served, owner occupancy of either unit, district water-efficiency standards, and continuous District customer at the parcel for at least one year. Non-qualifying ADUs pay DFU-proportioned charges (meter-size schedule not retrieved).

fee_items.source_note: Formerly 1% of assessed valuation on all building permits (Reso 11473, 2004); repealed by Resolution No. 15568, adopted June 15, 2026, so the line is $0.
fee_items.notes: Repeal's precise effective date and application to permits already in process were not pinned down (12/1 target). Scope in source: detached ADU.

fee_items.fee_name: Accessory Dwelling Unit planning fee (Planning Division Line 18, with surcharges)
fee_items.source_note: FY 2026-27 Master Fee Schedule, Planning Division Line 18: Accessory Dwelling Unit $866 base + 5% General Plan Update ($43) + 4% Technology ($34) + 3% Permit Streamlining ($25) = $968 total.
fee_items.notes: Standalone ADU planning fee; Ordinance No. 1890 section 16.303.05(A) ties ADU applications to the Master Fee Schedule review fees. Scope in source: detached ADU.

fee_items.fee_name: Sanitary sewer capacity charge — detached ADU, 800-899 sq ft, Mainland (Vallejo Flood & Wastewater District)
fee_items.source_note: VFWD Schedule of Rates eff. 7/1/2026, District Code 4.04.070: ADU capacity bands; 800-899 sq ft Mainland = $2,865. Bands start at 501 sq ft; contained ADUs are never charged.
fee_items.notes: Mare Island schedule differs (800-899 sq ft $3,325); Sears Point supplemental $615/EDU is parcel-specific and not included. The district Developers page wording (post-hoc ADUs pay admin fees only vs. concurrent ADUs pay admin + capacity) sits in tension with the codified band — flagged for 12/1. Scope in source: detached ADU.

fee_items.fee_name: VFWD plan review — Minor Residential 1-2 units (includes ADU new construction)
fee_items.source_note: VFWD Schedule of Rates eff. 7/1/2026, Development Services Administrative Fees: Plan Review, Minor Residential 1-2 Units (expressly includes ADU new construction; up to 3 submittals) $580 per permit.
fee_items.notes: Scope in source: detached ADU.

fee_items.source_note: VFWD Schedule of Rates eff. 7/1/2026, Development Services Administrative Fees: Inspection $400 per permit.
fee_items.notes: Scope in source: detached ADU.

fee_items.source_note: VFWD Schedule of Rates eff. 7/1/2026, Development Services Administrative Fees: Permit Processing $61.94 per permit/per unit.
fee_items.notes: Admin subtotal with plan review and inspection: $1,041.94. Scope in source: detached ADU.

fee_items.fee_name: School district developer fee (Covina-Valley USD; most of city)
fee_items.source_note: CVUSD Developer Fee Form: $5.38/sq ft residential (SAB 2026 maximum, Res. 25-26-13 eff. 5/11/2026); 800 sq ft = $4,304. CVUSD covers most of Covina; eastern/Charter Oak USD parcels differ and that district's rate was not found — verify per parcel (12/1 target).

fee_items.fee_name: Administrative Design Review — Minor: New Single Family Residence, ADU/JADU
fee_items.source_note: FY2026-27 Community Development Master Fee Schedule (eff. 7/1/2026): ADR-Minor 'New Single Family Residence, ADU/JADU' $1,970 per application — the named planning line for the spec scenario. Whether it is collected on every detached ADU vs. only where design review is triggered was not stated — 12/1 target.
FY2026-27 Exhibit A Building Permit Fees: Permit Issuance $63.00 each.
FY2026-27 Exhibit A: Technology/Training Surcharge 0.0025 of valuation (0.25%).
SB 1473 Green Building Standards fee: $1 per each $25,000 of valuation or fraction thereof, minimum $1.

fee_items.fee_name: State Strong Motion Instrumentation Program fee (SMIP, residential)
fee_items.source_note: CA SMIP: 0.013% of valuation for residential up to 3 stories.

fee_items.fee_name: School district developer fee (Salinas-area pockets: SUHSD Level II, shared)
fee_items.source_note: SUHSD Resolution No. 26-92 (adopted 6/9/2026): Level II $4.82/sq ft residential, shared by feeder districts and the high school district; 800 sq ft = $3,856. Covers Salinas-area unincorporated pockets only — North County (NMCUSD) and other areas differ; see research file (12/1 targets).
fee_items.notes: Salinas-area pockets only; not a countywide rate.

fee_items.fee_name: County development impact / park / construction tax (none adopted)
fee_items.source_note: OC Public Works Development Services fee schedule (Res. 24-058, eff. 7/21/2024) searched in full: zero impact-fee, Quimby, or construction-tax entries; county ADU path is ministerial (Zoning Code Sec. 7-9-90). County DIF/park/construction tax = $0 for the spec ADU. TCA corridor DIF (south-county benefit area) is separate and PARTIAL.

City FAQ: general contractors pay 0.2125% of project valuation per project at permit issuance (subcontractors under the GC covered). Levied on the contractor, but a real valuation-scaled cost of every Beverly Hills permit.
fee_items.notes: Levied on the general contractor, not the owner directly.
